author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing was a box with two big solid dots under an open top with one squiggle, and it read as a robot or a face. Redrawn around the reference's subject: a flat baking tray with upturned rims holding three round cookies, with a wisp of steam rising from each one to say they are fresh from the oven.
omissions: The oven box behind the tray and the tray's perspective were dropped. Only three ring cookies fit 8 apart (the reference has four ovals).
